title: Small. Just ok.
text: Small. Just ok.. These are smaller dessert/side plates. They are thin porcelain and have a slight blue undertone. The plates all have weird black dots strewn on the glaze. I included a pic with my review so you can see for yourself. There’s one or two on each plate. It’s a bummer because they are so evident even when your table is set. ☹️
